data.content: KB v1.6 kappa = 0.065 S/cm (22 C), 0.086 S/cm (40 C) is [C] +/-20%. The Braun 2020 low-acid value 0.075 S/cm @298 K independently supports the 22 C magnitude. No direct measurement for 65 g/L Cu + 8 g/L H2SO4 vs T was found in accessible literature; MEASURE IT (P2 cell resistance gives kappa via R = L/(kappa*A)).

notes: GAP: no measured kappa(T) series for a 65 g/L Cu / 8 g/L H2SO4 bath found. Conductivity of CuSO4-H2SO4-H2O mixtures was measured by Hotlos & Jaskula 1988 (Hydrometallurgy 21:1, doi 10.1016/0304-386X(88)90012-6, densities+viscosities, [AB] not read) - likely also contains conductivity; not retrieved. Recommendation: treat kappa as a to-measure parameter with prior N(0.075 S/cm, 20%) at 22 C.
